title: Type system — quick overview
rememberThis: var infers a static type; it is not dynamic or JS var.
decimal for money and grades; double for graphics/science.
Value assignment copies; reference assignment aliases. Boxing wraps values as object.
int? is Nullable<int>; string? is still a reference (NRT in module 07). dynamic is not TS unknown.
bullets: Locals need definite assignment; fields default.
typeof is compile-time; GetType is run-time; is/as test compatibility.
Catalog: class, struct, record, interface, enum, tuple, generic.
Stack vs heap details and GC: module 14.
